visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-framed glasses and a black t-shirt stands in a bright, modern white kitchen, speaking expressively to the camera while holding a small card. The background features a large silver refrigerator and wooden chairs. (2) He transitions to holding a white clipboard with a structured chart titled 'Long-term weight maintenance training table', pointing at it to explain his plan. (3) The man begins stretching his arms and back, exhibiting a pained facial expression as if he has muscle soreness. (4) He walks through the kitchen, searches the refrigerator, and pulls out several large cartons of milk and a green bottle. (5) Holding the heavy grocery items to his chest, he performs multiple squats in the center of the kitchen floor, wearing beige shorts. (6) He sets the items down and performs push-ups on the floor, appearing physically exhausted and sweating slightly. (7) He finishes the exercise by squatting down low, looking directly into the camera lens with a weary expression. (8) The scene cuts to a simple 2D animation of a man lying on a yellow background with a woman standing nearby.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the 'Fat Diary' in Traditional Chinese. Speech is fast and clear with a humorous, self-deprecating tone. No background music is present. (2) Vocal continues as the speaker complains about overeating and lack of discipline. The sound of a plastic clipboard being handled creates a sharp, percussive thud. (3) Speaker transitions into grunts and strained vocalizations as he describes back pain from golf. (4) Distinct mechanical sound of a refrigerator door opening followed by the metallic clinking of bottles and cartons being grabbed. (5) Heavy breathing and rhythmic grunts accompany the sound of floor contact during squats and push-ups. Vocal strain is prominent. (6) A sharp, synthesized 'Ding' sound effect marks the transition to the outro jingle, which is a short, bright electronic pop melody.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Context -> Problem -> Improvised Solution -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic lifestyle vlog documenting a creator's attempt to exercise at home using heavy kitchen groceries as weights. The video uses relatable humor about post-vacation overeating to engage viewers and promote a fitness-oriented mindset in a domestic setting.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features dense variety-style text overlays and jump cuts common in East Asian social media vlogs to maintain a high level of viewer engagement and comedic timing.
